deck_title: Perlin C2 quintic smoothstep vs classic C1 cubic Mach-band crease rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Ken Perlin (SIGGRAPH 2002 "Improving Noise") & Inigo Quilez C2 quintic smoothstep polynomial (S_5(u) = 6u^5 - 15u^4 + 10u^3 = u^3(10 + u(-15 + 6u)), locking second derivative S_5''(0) = S_5''(1) = 0.0000) versus classic C1 cubic Hermite smoothstep (S_3(u) = 3u^2 - 2u^3, suffering S_3''(0) = +6.0000 and S_3''(1) = -6.0000 boundary curvature jumps) and 64-substep Regularized Incomplete Beta I_u(3,3) quadrature across 17 stations (u in [0.0000, 1.0000]).

Camera rail & rigged character ease-in/ease-out transitions requiring zero acceleration jump (zero jerk impulse) at keyframe endpoints
SDF smooth blending and displacement map stitching across grid boundaries without Mach-band creases

not_for: Rough unlit opacity masks where C1 cubic 3u^2-2u^3 is visually indistinguishable and saves 2 FMAs
Monotonic data interpolation with arbitrary non-zero endpoint tangents (use Fritsch-Carlson)
